faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What types of bags do you sell?
faq.a1: We sell a wide range of bags including school bags, college bags, office bags, laptop bags, backpacks, travel bags, trolley bags, suitcases, duffel bags, kids bags, hand bags and travel accessories.
faq.q2: Do you offer suitcase repair services?
faq.a2: Yes, we provide professional repair services for suitcases, trolley bags and all types of bags. Our services include wheel replacement, handle repair, zip repair, lock repair and more.
faq.q3: Can you replace trolley bag wheels?
faq.a3: Yes, we replace all types of trolley bag wheels with high-quality replacements. We carry wheels of various sizes and types to match your trolley bag.
faq.q4: How long does a typical repair take?
faq.a4: Most repairs are completed within 1-2 days. Simple repairs like zip fixes may be done the same day. Complex repairs may take 2-3 days.
faq.a5: We are located at 50, West Vadampokki Street, near Koodal Azhagar Temple and Periyar Bus Stand in Madurai.
faq.a6: Yes! You can message us on WhatsApp for product enquiries, repair quotes and any other questions. Click the WhatsApp button on our website to start a chat.
faq.a7: We are open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Sunday hours may vary, please call or WhatsApp to confirm.
